cards.example_en: There is a risk of ice on the bridge tonight.
cards.example_zh: 今晚桥上有结冰的风险。

cards.example_en: We fished in the river behind my uncle's house.
cards.example_zh: 我们在叔叔家后面的河流里钓鱼。

cards.example_en: The road into the village is narrow and very bumpy.
cards.example_zh: 进村的马路又窄又非常颠簸。

cards.example_en: The robot can carry books.
cards.example_zh: 这个机器人能搬书。

cards.example_en: They climbed a large rock during the geography outing.
cards.example_zh: 地理郊游时，他们爬上了一块大岩石。

cards.example_en: The rocket rose into the sky.
cards.example_zh: 火箭升上天空。

cards.example_en: My role in the school play is the station master.
cards.example_zh: 我在校园剧里的角色是站长。

cards.example_en: This room is quiet.
cards.example_zh: 这个房间很安静。

cards.example_en: Hold the rope when you climb.
cards.example_zh: 攀爬时抓住绳子。

cards.example_en: Mum put a yellow rose in a glass of water.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈把一朵黄玫瑰花插进了一杯水里。

cards.example_en: We lost the opening round but won the quiz final.
cards.example_zh: 我们输了开头的回合，却赢下了问答决赛。

cards.example_en: Our class sat in the second row for the concert.
cards.example_zh: 我们班坐在音乐会的第二排。

cards.example_en: Put the rubbish in the bin.
cards.example_zh: 将垃圾放入垃圾桶。

cards.example_en: One firm rule says nobody may run beside the pool.
cards.example_zh: 有一条硬规则：谁也不准在水池边奔跑。

cards.example_en: Draw the line with a ruler.
cards.example_zh: 用尺子画这条线。

cards.example_en: I run around the playground before morning class.
cards.example_zh: 上午上课前，我绕着操场跑步。

cards.example_en: Don't rush across the road when the light is red.
cards.example_zh: 红灯亮时不要冲过马路。

cards.example_en: A sad film left the whole family quiet after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 一部悲伤的电影让全家人晚饭后都安静下来。

cards.example_en: The children are safe inside during the thunderstorm.
cards.example_zh: 雷雨的时候，孩子们安全地待在室内。

cards.example_en: Safety comes first when you cross the road.
cards.example_zh: 过马路时，安全第一。

cards.example_en: Lunch was chicken and a green salad.
cards.example_zh: 午饭是鸡肉和一份蔬菜沙拉。

cards.example_en: The winter book sale drew a long queue outside.
cards.example_zh: 冬季图书特卖让门外排起了长队。

cards.example_en: Too much salt ruined the soup we had at dinner.
cards.example_zh: 盐放得太多，我们晚饭的汤全毁了。

cards.example_en: We live on the same street.
cards.example_zh: 我们住在同一条街上。

cards.example_en: Warm sand stuck to our feet after the sea swim.
cards.example_zh: 在海里游完，温热的沙子粘在我们脚上。

cards.example_en: I ate a chicken sandwich on the crowded school bus.
cards.example_zh: 我在拥挤的校车上吃了一个鸡肉三明治。

cards.example_en: A simple lunch can satisfy us after football practice.
cards.example_zh: 足球训练之后，一顿简单的午饭就能使我们满意。

cards.example_en: Lifeguards save swimmers who drift too far from shore.
cards.example_zh: 救生员救起那些漂得离岸太远的游泳者。

cards.example_en: What did Grandma say about the burnt rice?
cards.example_zh: 奶奶对烧糊的米饭说了什么？

cards.example_en: Thunder can scare young children.
cards.example_zh: 雷声会吓到小孩子。

cards.example_en: She wrapped a warm scarf around her neck.
cards.example_zh: 她在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。

cards.example_en: Our school starts at eight o'clock.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校八点开始上课。

cards.example_en: My schoolbag is too heavy today.
cards.example_zh: 我的书包今天太重了。

cards.example_en: In science we heated three metals to see what melts.
cards.example_zh: 科学课上，我们给三种金属加热，看哪种会熔化。

cards.example_en: A visiting scientist showed our class a tiny robot.
cards.example_zh: 一位来访的科学家给我们班看了一个小机器人。

cards.example_en: Use scissors to cut the paper.
cards.example_zh: 用剪刀剪纸。

cards.example_en: My score on the listening test went up by ten marks.
cards.example_zh: 我听力测试的分数提高了十分。

cards.example_en: I cleaned the dusty screen before the online lesson.
cards.example_zh: 上网课之前，我把落满灰尘的屏幕擦干净了。

cards.example_en: We collected shells by the sea during the holiday.
cards.example_zh: 放假的时候，我们在海边捡贝壳。

cards.example_en: The search for my lost keys took the whole evening.
cards.example_zh: 寻找丢失的钥匙花了整整一个晚上。

cards.example_en: Autumn is my favourite season because leaves turn red.
cards.example_zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节，因为树叶会变红。

cards.example_en: Save me a seat near the front of the school bus.
cards.example_zh: 在校车靠前的位置给我留一个位子。

cards.example_en: She wrote the secret message in tiny letters.
cards.example_zh: 她用很小的字写下了那条秘密信息。

cards.example_en: I can see the mountains from our upstairs window.
cards.example_zh: 从我们楼上的窗户能看见群山。

cards.example_en: You seem tired after the long maths test.
cards.example_zh: 漫长的数学测验之后，你似乎很疲倦。

cards.example_en: He seldom arrives late.
cards.example_zh: 他很少迟到。

cards.example_en: Farmers sell sweet corn outside the school on Fridays.
cards.example_zh: 农民星期五在学校外面出售甜玉米。

cards.example_en: I will send Grandma a photo of the snowman.
cards.example_zh: 我要给奶奶发送一张雪人的照片。

cards.example_en: The last sentence makes no sense without the chart.
cards.example_zh: 没有那张图表，最后一句就讲不通。

cards.example_en: Please write a full sentence.
cards.example_zh: 请写一个完整的句子。

word.example_en: We may run out of paper this afternoon.
word.example_zh: 今天下午纸可能会用完。

word.example_en: These shirts are on sale today.
word.example_zh: 这些衬衫今天减价出售。

word.example_en: They laughed and cried at the same time.
You should say sorry to your classmate.
He is at school until four.
The children go to school by bus.
They search for the lost dog in the park.
word.example_zh: 他们在公园里搜寻走失的狗。

word.example_en: The country will send up another satellite.
word.example_zh: 这个国家将再发射一颗卫星。

word.example_en: We will send for a doctor if the pain grows.
word.example_zh: 如果疼痛加重，我们会派人去请医生。
